Mesham.description: The sign Aries rises with its head. It is blood-red in colour, quadruped, strong during the night. It is a medium-sized sign and is powerful in forests. It denotes courage, assertiveness, physical energy, and leadership ability.

Rishabam.description: Taurus rises with its back. It is white, quadruped, strong during the daytime. It lives on land and occupies forests. It is a powerful and fertile sign denoting love of beauty, material stability and sensory pleasures.

Mithunam.description: Gemini is represented by a couple. It is green, rising with its head, powerful during the night. It denotes dual nature, intellectual versatility, communication skill and adaptability.

Kadagam.description: Cancer is a watery sign ruled by the Moon. It has many legs (crab), is pale red, and rises with the back. It is powerful at night and denotes mothering, emotions, intuition and deep attachment.

Simmam.description: Leo is a powerful, royal sign represented by a lion. It rises with its head, is tawny-coloured, and dominates forests and mountains. It denotes authority, dignity, creativity and leadership.

Kanni.description: Virgo is a biped sign, represented by a virgin holding grains. It rises with the head, is variegated in colour. It denotes analytical ability, service, purity and attention to detail.

Thulaam.description: Libra is a biped sign represented by a man with scales. It rises with its head and is strong during the day. It denotes balance, justice, diplomacy and partnership.

Viruchigam.description: Scorpio is a many-legged sign inhabiting water. It is reddish-brown and has serpent nature. It denotes intensity, transformation, secret knowledge, occult and regenerative power.

Dhanusu.description: Sagittarius is a sign with the upper body of a man and lower body of a horse, holding a bow and arrow. It denotes philosophy, higher learning, long travels, optimism and spiritual seeking.

Makaram.description: Capricorn is represented by a sea-goat with the front of a deer and the tail of a fish. It is four-footed in front. It denotes ambition, discipline, responsibility and karma.

Kumbam.description: Aquarius is represented by a man carrying a pot of water. It is a biped sign, powerful during the day. It denotes humanitarianism, intellect, originality and social reform.

Meenam.description: Pisces is represented by two fish moving in opposite directions. It is a watery sign, powerful during the night. It denotes spirituality, compassion, imagination and dissolution of boundaries.

Ashwini.description: Born under Ashwini are energetic, quick-witted healers with great leadership. They are pioneers, love speed and new beginnings. Quick to start but need persistence.

Bharani.description: Born under Bharani are enduring, disciplined and bear the burden of responsibility. They understand the laws of karma deeply. Creative and possessive.

Krittika.description: Krittika natives are sharp, courageous and determined. They cut through obstacles. They are natural leaders with warmth when channelled correctly.

Rohini.description: The most fertile and beautiful Nakshatra. Rohini natives are creative, sensual and deeply magnetic. They love luxury, art and beautiful things.

Mrigashira.description: Gentle, delicate and eternally searching. Mrigashira natives are seekers, researchers and wanderers. Sensitive and artistic.

Ardra.description: Ardra brings storms of transformation. Natives are intellectually brilliant, emotionally intense and undergo massive life changes that purify the soul.

Punarvasu.description: The Nakshatra of return and renewal. Natives are optimistic, loving and deeply philosophical. They bounce back from adversity with grace.

Pushya.description: The most auspicious Nakshatra. Pushya natives are nourishing, supportive, deeply spiritual and protective. Excellent for starting important ventures.

Ashlesha.description: Mystical, hypnotic and deeply intuitive. Ashlesha natives have sharp perception, healing power and can be deeply manipulative or deeply wise.

Magha.description: The royal Nakshatra of ancestors. Magha natives are proud, ambitious, deeply connected to their lineage and are natural leaders who command respect.

Purva Phalguni.description: The Nakshatra of luxury and relaxation. Natives are creative, romantic, love the good life and are gifted in the performing arts and entertainment.

Uttara Phalguni.description: Uttara Phalguni natives are reliable, social, helpful and responsible. They build lasting relationships and are excellent in partnerships.

Hasta.description: Hasta natives are skilled with their hands, crafty, clever and analytical. They excel in any vocation requiring manual skill, artistry or healing.

Chitra.description: The Nakshatra of the master architect. Chitra natives are brilliant, creative, artistic and are drawn to beauty in all its forms. They build beautiful things.

Swati.description: Independent as the wind. Swati natives desire freedom above all, are skilled in business, crafting and adapt perfectly to new environments.

Vishakha.description: Vishakha natives are ambitious, goal-oriented and determined. They pursue their aims with singular focus and do not give up until total victory.

Anuradha.description: The Nakshatra of devotion and friendship. Anuradha natives are deeply loyal, loving and make excellent friends and leaders who nurture their groups.

Jyeshtha.description: The eldest and most powerful. Jyeshtha natives are natural protectors, highly capable, intense and often bear heavy responsibilities for others.

Mula.description: The Nakshatra of dissolution and roots. Mula natives dig deep into the mysteries of life, face sudden upheavals and ultimately find profound spiritual truths.

Purva Ashadha.description: Invincible before the final victory. Natives are proud, courageous, persuasive and have great energy for conquering their goals.

Uttara Ashadha.description: Final victory. Uttara Ashadha natives are noble, righteous, virtuous and achieve lasting success. They are natural leaders with great public responsibility.

Shravana.description: The Nakshatra of listening and learning. Shravana natives are excellent listeners, learners and teachers. They connect people and share knowledge widely.

Dhanishta.description: The Nakshatra of wealth and music. Dhanishta natives are musically gifted, ambitious, quick in action and accumulate great wealth through their versatile talents.

Shatabhisha.description: The great healer. Shatabhisha natives are mysterious, secretive, deeply healing, and are drawn to medicine, research and the hidden mysteries of the cosmos.

Purva Bhadrapada.description: Fiery transformation. Purva Bhadrapada natives are intense, idealistic, passionate and may renounce ordinary life in pursuit of higher spiritual goals.

Uttara Bhadrapada.description: The nakshatra of depth and wisdom. These natives are wise, compassionate, deeply spiritual and often serve as pillars of support for families and communities.

Revati.description: The final Nakshatra. Revati natives are gentle, compassionate, creative and are the nurturers of the zodiac. They guide others to their destination.
